notes: The West Virginia All-State Chorus is administered by the West Virginia Vocal Music Association (WVVMA), the choral affiliate of WVMEA, and performs at the WVMEA In-Service Conference. The 2027 performance repertoire and guest conductor ARE published; the 2027 dates, deadlines, and fees are NOT — WVMEA's home page says only 'MARCH 2027' with details to be announced in Fall 2026, and the posted Step-By-Step Guide is still the 2025-26 edition. Two program entries share the lineage key: one for 2026-27 (repertoire and conductor only) and one for 2025-26 (the published dates, fees, and process). The 2025-26 figures must NOT be read as 2026-27. West Virginia's model is unusual: schools apply and receive a voice-part allotment, the DIRECTOR chooses which students represent the school via in-school auditions, and students then sing regional auditions on random selections from the full All-State repertoire.

organization.name: West Virginia Vocal Music Association
organization.description: WVVMA is West Virginia's choral organization and the administrator of the West Virginia All-State Chorus, which rehearses and performs in conjunction with the West Virginia Music Educators Association (WVMEA) In-Service Conference. WVVMA also runs the state show choir program and maintains the state choral directory.

programs.name: West Virginia All State Chorus
programs.description: The 2027 West Virginia All State Chorus, conducted by Dr. Cara Tasher (University of North Florida). The 2027 repertoire program has been published; dates and fees for 2027 have not. WVVMA notes that directors must obtain the correct editions matching the JW Pepper links it provides.

dates.title: 2027 WVMEA In-Service Conference (All-State Chorus performance)
dates.description: WVMEA has announced only 'MARCH 2027' with more details to be announced in Fall 2026. No specific 2027 dates are published.

requirements.title: Original copies of the repertoire required
requirements.description: Directors order the repertoire from the WVVMA/WVMEA All State Chorus Repertoire page. Original copies are required; no photocopies are allowed. Directors must obtain the editions matching the JW Pepper links WVVMA provides.

requirements.title: Regional auditions draw random selections from all pieces
requirements.description: Each regional audition includes random selections from all pieces in the All-State program; directors are instructed to prepare students for every measure of every piece.

repertoire.title: Sicut Cervus
repertoire.notes: A cappella; Latin. WVVMA lists IMSLP as the score location.

repertoire.title: Anoj Pusej Dunojelio
repertoire.notes: SATB with soprano/tenor solo; Lithuanian. WVVMA posts a Lithuanian pronunciation guide and a practice audio file.

repertoire.title: To the Mothers in Brazil/Salve Regina
repertoire.notes: SATB with improvised percussion, piano and cello; Latin.

repertoire.title: O Love
repertoire.notes: SATB with piano and cello; English.

repertoire.title: Fire
repertoire.notes: SATB with body percussion and percussion.

repertoire.title: We Rise Again
repertoire.notes: Composer credit reproduced as spelled on the WVVMA page.

programs.name: West Virginia All State Chorus
programs.description: The 2025-26 cycle of the West Virginia All State Chorus, as published in WVVMA's Step-By-Step Guide. Included because WVVMA had not yet replaced the guide with a 2026-27 edition at the retrieval date — these dates and fees are prior-season and should not be presented as 2026-27.

dates.title: School application deadline
dates.description: Schools submit the School Application indicating the number of each voice part they plan to bring, with proof of NAfME membership and the school registration check.

dates.title: WVMEA Conference early-bird director registration
dates.description: Directors must register for the WVMEA Conference at wvmea.org; early-bird rate applies through this date (fee information listed as subject to change).

dates.title: All State Chorus event
dates.description: Charleston Civic Center. Rehearsals Thursday through Saturday morning; concert Saturday afternoon. All rehearsals are mandatory.

requirements.title: Current active NAfME/WVMEA membership required
requirements.description: Directors must hold a current, active NAfME (WVMEA) membership in the Mountain State, and must submit proof of membership (membership card) with the school application.

requirements.title: School application and voice-part allotment
requirements.description: Schools register using the School Application and indicate the number of each voice part they plan to bring; listing individual students is not required at that stage. The number of parts requested is not guaranteed — allotments are posted after all school applications are received.

requirements.title: In-school auditions select the school's representatives
requirements.description: Directors conduct auditions at their own school according to the allotment provided and choose which students represent the school.

requirements.title: Signed student application
requirements.description: Individual student applications must be printed and signed by an administrator and a parent/guardian.

requirements.title: Regional auditions
requirements.description: Audition times and locations are set by each region chair. WVVMA is organized into six regions (Regions 1-6) each with a regional chairperson.

fees.description: $75 school registration, paid by check from a school or booster account only (no personal checks), payable to 'West Virginia All State Chorus' and mailed to the All State Chair.
$35 per student registration fee, which includes a T-shirt. Submitted as one school/booster check (no personal checks).
$100 early-bird WVMEA Conference registration for directors (by January 17); the guide notes fee information is subject to change.
